definitions.explanation: The collective term for leading figures and organizations in the business and financial sectors. Refers to the community of major corporate executives, industry leaders, and business organizations that influence economic policy.

examples.japanese: {財界|ざいかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{重鎮|じゅうちん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Leading figures of the business world gathered.

examples.japanese: {財界|ざいかい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}{政策|せいさく}→経済政策：21753_keizaiseisaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反発|はんぱつ}した→反発する：26991_hanpatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: The business community opposed the government's economic policy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧{財界|ざいかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧し、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{貢献|こうけん}した→貢献する：21682_koukensuru⟧。
examples.english: He was active in the business world for many years and contributed to the growth of many companies.

notes:
Refers to the collective sphere of influential business leaders and major corporate organizations, often in the context of their political influence or economic role.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {財界|ざいかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{重鎮|じゅうちん}: a leading figure in the business world
- {財界|ざいかい}⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧: businessperson; business leader
- {財界|ざいかい}⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧: business organization
- {政|せい}{財界|ざいかい}: political and business circles

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{経済界|けいざいかい}→経済界：24307_keizaikai⟧: economic world — broader, includes academia and policy
- {実業界|じつぎょうかい}: the industrial world — focuses more on actual business operations
- ⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧: industry — refers to a specific trade or sector, not the business world as a whole
